cover.scope: Native component also includes folded flex; complete component depth is not front glass thickness.

facts.method: Retained original CAD/dimensioned source measurements and registered photographs; unknown values and visual estimates are explicit.
facts.notes: All 728 native source components, including five open shells, are retained in their original millimetre assembly positions. Small components are grouped for rendering only; each source index is independently exported and bounds-checked. SKU34957 includes a separate lithium battery; SKU34958 (-EN) omits it. This model is the native board/display assembly, without an invented battery or external speaker placement. No additional enclosure is present in the supplied assembly. The 0.70 mm cover reference in the PDF is a front laminate dimension. Native touch component0 also includes folded flex reaching below the PCB; its 7.00 mm total component depth is not glass thickness. The LCD AA is 43.20×57.60 mm. The separate touch VA is 43.80×58.20 mm, and cover outer size50.54×73.06 mm has R2 corners. The runtime uses rectangular AA, not cover or VA dimensions. Native PCB49.913581×69.011087×1.600000 mm differs slightly from PDF nominal49.90×69.00×1.60 mm. Native geometry is preserved without scaling. BOOT is physical component9 and binds to runtime control boot, GPIO28 active-low. RESET component8 and power component712 remain visible but unbound; PWR belongs to the CH32/power circuit and is not exposed as a fictitious ordinary GPIO key. Native shielding part271 has the reused library name ESP32-WROOM-32E_SHIELDING_CASE_. This is a mechanical library label in the explicit C5 assembly; it is not evidence that the board uses a classic ESP32. The actual C5 module identity comes from separate electrical sources and photographs. Native colors are retained except for a dark optical cover and black PCB, selected from the exact official photographs. Source photographs remain unchanged references and no stock screenshot replaces the live framebuffer. Optical text-to-USB registration and physical fit have not been calibrated on hardware. The identity transform preserves the supplied portrait assembly and 240×320 framebuffer shape; firmware/native execution is separately documented. Repository and CAD dates are source dates, not a product release-date certification or proof of a specific shipping PCB revision. Native parts are not Boolean-unioned; any source assembly overlaps remain as provided. The 0.008 mm screen offset is a rendering offset, not a physical layer. No pre-reset model, source archive or lost historical acceptance result is reused.

collectionNotes: 公开入口为项目 SRAM 诊断；原厂 ROM 在第 6831 条指令读取 PMU 0x600b00e4 时停止，原始镜像独立列为参考。
原生与公开 Worker／WASM 已验证完整 8 MiB PSRAM、GDMA 出屏、CST3530 触摸和 BOOT；6 阶段画面逐字节相同，整张默认 64 MiB FAT32 卡在块读写后恢复；浏览器 WebGL 与 FAT 挂载未验收。
物理模块为 32 MiB Flash、8 MiB PSRAM；官方当前镜像使用 16 MiB Flash 布局，不据此缩减物理容量。
CH32V003 仅实现文档中的 8 位数字 IO／PWM 协议；未知命令、充电、电池 ADC、SHTC3、I2S 音频、USB、无线和电源键不冒充已实现。
3D 已根据可用官方资料建立；物理 PWM 频率、触摸扫描时序和姿态方向尚未标定。
Physical module32F8P; officialcurrentfactory/appheader andsdkconfig use16MiBflash layout. Preserve both facts.
docs/ch32v003.md assignsSHTC3 toEXIO4/5 while schematic signal table puts itsbus onGPIO0/1; unimplementedSHTC3 is not assigned a speculative route.
Resourcepage explicitlyQMI8658C vs genericQMI8658 in schematic; modelCvariant withphysicalgroundedSA0=6B only.
同页 EN SKU34958 已发现，语言固件对应关系尚未核验；基础 SKU 镜像不自动代替 EN。
公开执行和完整默认卡恢复证据：docs/evidence/waveshare-c5-touch28-web-2026-11-23/result.json。
3D 来源：官方 CAD 机械参考。 生产加载器几何与输入射线已检查；浏览器 WebGL 和实物装配尚未验收。
官方 SKU 34957；套装选项：with 3.7V Lithium Batt。电池与排针包装差异不代表额外固件或实机验收。
共用板型的既有测试只证明已建模数字接口；不继承任何真实硬件、摄像头、射频或电池验证。
